one_line: Early Vakataka emperor and Vedic sacrificer who forged a Deccan empire through ritual sovereignty.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a solid, warrior-king build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short boxed beard; sharp, focused eyes with slightly arched brows and a calm, commanding default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a high knot at the back of the crown, smooth on top, with a simple narrow gold band circlet resting above the forehead and a small red tilaka mark at the center.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early-Gupta–age Deccan royal attire: a knee-length off-white cotton anga-vastra tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, worn over a tightly wrapped saffron-yellow dhoti tied at the waist and pleated to fall just above the ankles; over his left shoulder and around his torso is a rich deep-red silk uttarīya shawl with a narrow gold border, draped so it crosses his chest diagonally; he wears a broad gold waist-belt with a simple rectangular clasp, medium-width gold armlets on both upper arms, modest gold bangles, and small round gold earrings; his feet are in plain brown leather sandals, and his overall silhouette is modest but regal, with the drape of the shawl suggesting both ritual and martial authority.
appearance.signature: A long, plain wooden Vedic staff (danda) in polished dark-brown wood, capped with simple bronze at both ends, held upright in his right hand as a symbol of ritual kingship and disciplined authority.

ref_desc: Pravarasena I is a medium-brown, strong-built mid-40s king with black hair in a high knot, a short beard, a gold circlet and red tilaka, wearing an off-white tunic, saffron dhoti, deep-red gold-bordered shawl, gold ornaments, brown sandals, and holding a dark-brown Vedic staff with bronze caps.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pravarasena I: a tall, broad-shouldered Deccan king in his mid-40s with an oval medium-brown face, strong jaw, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short boxed beard, and sharp focused eyes under slightly arched brows; his black hair is pulled into a smooth high knot at the back of the crown, topped by a simple narrow gold circlet, and a small red tilaka mark sits at the center of his forehead. He wears an off-white knee-length cotton tunic with short sleeves and a subtle woven border, over a tightly wrapped saffron-yellow dhoti that is pleated and falls just above the ankles. A rich deep-red silk uttarīya shawl with a narrow gold border is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his torso, suggesting both ritual and royal presence. A broad gold waist-belt with a rectangular clasp cinches his waist, with medium-width gold armlets on both upper arms, modest gold bangles, small round gold earrings, and plain brown leather sandals completing the look. In his right hand he holds a long polished dark-brown wooden Vedic staff with simple bronze caps at both ends, standing upright as a central prop. Show him from head to toe with clear, consistent colouring: saffron-yellow, deep red, off-white, gold, and dark brown as the dominant palette, emphasizing a dignified, commanding but composed expression suitable for a Vedic-sacrificing emperor.
